message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth Reversal", "construction": "Compute percentage change in total assets over the most recent quarter, then reverse-sort: focus on stocks with the largest declines in assets over the past quarter.", "rationale": "Firms rapidly reducing assets may be recovering from overinvestment or divesting unproductive segments, potentially boosting future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with the most negative recent quarterly asset growth"}, {"name": "R&D to Gross Margin Ratio", "construction": "Divide a company’s annual research & development expense by its trailing twelve-month gross margin.", "rationale": "High R&D spend relative to gross profits may indicate strong reinvestment in innovation and long-term competitive advantage.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Write-Down Ratio", "construction": "Sum inventory write-downs reported over the past year, divide by average total inventory for the same period.", "rationale": "Firms recognizing inventory obsolescence promptly may have more conservative accounting and better risk management, positioning for recovery.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Late Accounts Receivable Growth", "construction": "Calculate the 12-month change in accounts receivable, scaled by sales; focus on the top decile of increases.", "rationale": "Unusual growth in accounts receivable relative to sales may signal aggressive revenue recognition and higher risk, so lower growth may be positive.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Repurchase Yield", "construction": "Total cash spent on share buybacks minus cash received from share issuance, divided by market capitalization, over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms that shrink their share count may signal confidence in undervaluation and shareholder alignment.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "Calculate total revenue divided by the number of employees; use the year-over-year change in this ratio.", "rationale": "Rising revenue per employee can indicate operational efficiency improvements that may translate into higher profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Momentum", "construction": "Dummy variable equal to one for firms that initiated a dividend (paid a first dividend) in the past 12 months.", "rationale": "Firms beginning to pay dividends may have reached a new level of financial stability or profitability, signaling positive prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "recent initiators (value of one)"}, {"name": "Tax Rate Deviation", "construction": "Difference between the effective tax rate and the statutory federal tax rate, averaged over the past two years.", "rationale": "Firms with lower effective tax rates than the statutory rate may benefit from persistent tax advantages, raising future net income.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Minority Interest Growth", "construction": "12-month percentage change in minority interest reported on the balance sheet.", "rationale": "Rising minority interest may indicate profitable expansion of consolidated subsidiaries or joint ventures.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Revenue Ratio", "construction": "Deferred revenue at fiscal year-end divided by total assets.", "rationale": "High deferred revenue may signal strong future sales and cash flow visibility, supporting higher valuations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
